text.content:
Fuel, power, and a stadium with its name on it behind Hansen's wire.

Headquarters: A tower on the Corporate Plaza ring
Industry: Fuel, CHOOH2 and power
In Night City: Runs the city's power grid with Night Corp; owns the Northside refinery (#74)
Known for: EBM Petrochem Stadium, unfinished, now Barghest's fortress

Petrochem fought SovOil in the 2nd Corporate War and won the fuel business of half a continent. It licenses Biotechnica's CHOOH2, and with Night Corp it runs Night City's power grid; the corporate towers keep fusion plants of their own, and the Combat Zones run on stolen power and generators.

Its Northside refinery still runs behind Petrochem Security, making CHOOH2 and fuel, and Maelstrom taps its pipelines. The EBM Petrochem Stadium in Pacifica was part of the resort boom; Barghest took it unfinished in Operation Midnight Storm, and it is now the heart of the Occupied Zone.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 05, 08, 12
